subject: Provisioning concierge: OEM quote, cloud backfill and committed-pool sizing
messages:
From: Jorge Salazar <jorge.salazar@aquametrics.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: hw-sales@titan-oem.com, psingh@nova-cloud.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing for dedicated pool (AquaMetrics) - initial ask

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Per our discussion, AquaMetrics is planning to spin up a committed dedicated pool to support their real-time feature store + conversational assistant. High-level requirements attached. Quick summary below: 

- Target go-live: 2027-08-01 (hard customer commit)
- Steady-state concurrency: ~40 concurrent sessions, median seq len 1.5k tokens
- Expected average qps: 25 requests/sec (peaks to ~60 during business hours)
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 200ms for generation-only flows
- Data residency: us-west1

We requested an OEM quote from Titan and copied their sales rep — we need a consolidated plan: exact GPU SKU mix, procurement lead times, staggered delivery windows, and a cloud-backfill option for the first 6–8 weeks if HW is delayed. I attached the requirements spreadsheet (aquametrics_requirements.xlsx).

Can you confirm what commitment window we should ask the customer for, and whether Redwood recommends a tranche approach (initial small committed pool + burst-to-cloud)? Also flag any blockers around quantization or model variants that would change the SKU choices.

Appreciate a short runbook we can present to procurement and the customer.

Regards,
Jorge
Head of Platform, AquaMetrics
[Attachment: aquametrics_requirements.xlsx]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Salazar <jorge.salazar@aquametrics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing for dedicated pool (AquaMetrics) - provisioning concierge

Hi Jorge — thanks, received the sheet. Looping Ben (sales/commitment) and Laura (onboarding/CS) to land the timeline and procurement path. Short answers up front:

- Commitment window recommendation: staggered 3-tranche approach (baseline reserve to guarantee throughput + two follow-on tranches tied to usage milestones). We typically ask customers to sign the baseline commit that covers ~60% of peak expected tokens for the first 90 days.
- Cloud backfill: we can offer Nova Cloud (cc'd) as a temporary backfill for the first 6–8 weeks; we'll need to align IPs/regions and routing.
- SKU/quantization: Titan's A100-equivalent SKUs are fine for your models but if you plan to run 8-bit quantized variants we can push to more capacity per GPU. Need to verify model builds.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Ben to get Titan's firm ETAs and a revised quote with staged delivery options (attachment: titan_oem_quote_v2.pdf).
2) Laura to draft an onboarding calendar that assumes either (a) full HW delivery on 2027-07-15 or (b) partial delivery + cloud bridge.
3) Internal engineering check (Karthik) to confirm model quantization compatibility and KV cache sizing.

Ben/Laura: can you confirm you can turn around the playbook & quote reconciliation by EOD tomorrow so we can present to Jorge and Titan in the 5/18 sync?

Thanks — Steph
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_provisioning_playbook_v1.md]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jorge Salazar <jorge.salazar@aquametrics.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, hw-sales@titan-oem.com, psingh@nova-cloud.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Titan quote + lead-time analysis (AquaMetrics)

Forwarding Titan's updated quote and my commentary below.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Titan OEM Sales <hw-sales@titan-oem.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quote for AquaMetrics - v2
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Ben,
Attached is v2 with split delivery options: 8x SKUs on 2027-07-10 and remaining 16x SKUs on 2027-08-08. Lead time risk remains on the second tranche due to production sloting.

Regards,
Titan OEM Sales
[Attachment: titan_oem_quote_v2.pdf]

----- End forwarded message -----

Ben's analysis:
- Quote summary (from Titan v2): initial tranche 8x H-5800 equivalents (ship ETA 2027-07-10), follow-on 16x H-5800 (ETA 2027-08-08). Pricing aligns with our standard enterprise commitment schedule if AquaMetrics signs a 12-month reserved pool.
- Risk profile: 2–4 week variance on tranche 2 depending on Titan's production re-slot; customs and crossdock add another potential 1–2 weeks.
- Recommendation: request a 3-week soft buffer in the customer's go-live plan (target 2027-08-01 can be met if we stage capacity and route initial traffic to cloud during tranche gap).

Cloud backfill option (Nova Cloud, Priya cc'd):
- Nova can provide a geo-localized burst pool in us-west1 with equivalent GPU SKUs on a 30-day short-term contract. Pricing for the backfill is ~1.6x our committed rate but gives immediate capacity.
- We should coordinate IP whitelists, VPC peering, and routing policy to avoid double-billing and to preserve token accounting.

Action items:
- Laura: draft the onboarding calendar with two paths (HW-first and cloud-bridge).
- Karthik: can you validate whether the models can be pushed to 8-bit to reduce the required SKU count in tranche 2? If yes, we can compress tranche 2 by ~30%.
- Jorge: if AquaMetrics can accept a 3-week contingency in go-live, we keep risk low and avoid emergency inventory buys.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: titan_oem_quote_v2.pdf (forwarded)]

From: Priya Singh <psingh@nova-cloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jorge Salazar <jorge.salazar@aquametrics.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning concierge: Nova Cloud backfill terms and next steps

Hi all — quick confirmation from Nova Cloud side on the backfill option.

- We can provision a burst pool in us-west1 within 48–72 hours for the initial 8x GPU equivalent capacity.
- Contracting: we prefer a 30-day short-term agreement with an option to convert to 3-month term. We can share a draft order form (link below) and a short checklist for network pre-reqs.
- Pricing: 1.6x committed rate (as Ben noted). There is a one-time regional networking setup fee estimated at $2,500.
- Operational note: to preserve consistent latency SLOs we recommend routing control-plane calls through Redwood's smart-router and keeping model weights in a shared artifact registry. This avoids cold-start variance.

Docs/Links: 
Order form (draft): https://nova-cloud.com/orders/draft/AMX-12874
Network checklist: https://nova-cloud.com/support/edge-config

Happy to join the 5/18 customer sync or the 5/20 technical run-through.

Best,
Priya Singh
Partnerships, Nova Cloud
[Attachment: none]
